profile.name: Hamilton微孔板加热振荡器
profile.description: 用于微孔板样品加热与振荡混匀的实验室设备，可设定温度、启动或停止振荡，并可锁定板位以提高运行稳定性。常用于样品孵育、反应混合及自动化液体处理流程中的板上处理。
profile.description_en: A laboratory device for heating and shaking microplates, with controllable temperature, start/stop shaking, and plate locking for stable operation. It is commonly used for sample incubation, reaction mixing, and on-deck plate processing in automated liquid handling workflows.
